mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as nickName, u.avatar, u.person_introduction as personIntroduction, u.article_count as articleCount, u.follower_count as followerCount, u.following_count as followingCount, uf.focus_time as focusTime, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM user_focus WHERE user_id = #{currentUserId} AND focus_user_id = u.user_id ) as isFollowing FROM user_focus uf LEFT JOIN user_info u ON uf.user_id = u.user_id WHERE uf.focus_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.focus_time DESC
